purpose: Teach: 下方/私鉄/郵貯/竣工/インサイド/四方/ロイター/パーフェクト

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業績の下方修正は避けたい
lines.en: We need to avoid a downward earnings revision.
lines.style: Clipped, businesslike. Brief eye contact. No inflection—just fact-delivery. The tone of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。私鉄沿線への出店を検討します
lines.en: Understood. I'll look into expansion along the private rail lines.
lines.style: Steady, attentive. Slight nod on the opening. Note-taking rhythm to the pacing. Competent, not eager—just professional.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、郵貯口座での集金も継続しろ
lines.en: And keep collecting payments through postal savings accounts.
lines.style: Direct, economical. Matter-of-fact delivery. Lean forward slightly. No pause between clauses—it's an instruction, not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新工場の竣工式典を準備します
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate the opening ceremony for the new factory.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation. Slight upward inflection at 'ceremony'—acknowledging the task's weight. Deliberate, unhurried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界インサイド情報を整理しろ
lines.en: Make sure we're tracking insider information across the industry.
lines.style: Pointed. Weight on 'tracking.' Expectant pause after—waiting for acknowledgment. The tenor of someone delegating something important.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。四方からの市場圧力を分析します
lines.en: Understood. I'll analyze the market pressure coming from all sides.
lines.style: Measured response. Slight tension in the jaw—processing the complexity. Professional calm, but alert. No filler.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ロイター電を毎日確認しろ
lines.style: Clipped, final. Weight on 'every.' No room for negotiation in the delivery. The tone closes the conversation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。納期をパーフェクトに守ります
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure deadlines are met without exception.
lines.style: Firm closing statement. Slight harden in the spine. Affirmation—not a question. Steady eye contact. This is the last word.
